findings.mechanism: destination() accepts canonical component names containing spaces/Unicode/punctuation that replay-public.py rel() rejects. Example reports/final note.md is copied and emitted into SUPPORT_SHA256SUMS, then original public executor cannot parse that ledger.
findings.fix: Require every destination component to match the executor [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ and reject dot/dotdot; or independently fail-closed preflight the actual frozen plan against that exact consumer grammar before invoking this helper.

findings.mechanism: Only an exact LEDGER destination is reserved. SUPPORT_SHA256SUMS/child passes preflight and causes copied files to create a directory at generated ledger path, then fails late at ledger creation after outputs exist.
findings.fix: Reject any destination whose first component is LEDGER, in addition to repeated NAMESPACE; verify actual plan before activation.

checks: V2 SUPPORT entries are relative to target namespace/ledger parent, matching ledger(parent/name) lookup in public executor. Receipt stage_relative stays full-stage-relative.

Report helper diff adds one fixed PUBLIC_PROOF_PREFIX and optional receipt selector, and applies it only to public_replay_receipt. All other receipt links and history/fragment verification remain unchanged. Report/manifest templates byte-identical to frozen originals.

limits: Neither helper executed; no synthetic tests/plan exercise, SSH/network/Go/build/capture/GitHub/source/E mutation.
